_meta.notes: Cover is p1. THE FORM GOVERNS AND SETTLES THE CHUNK FLAG: the flag records this same URL listed twice by the clerk, as 'October' and as '2018 Summary Report'; the form's only checked Type-of-Report box is 'YEAR-END REPORT: January 31 of each year', ticked with an X, and 'Is this report an amendment?' is ticked No. So this is a Year-End report and neither listing label describes it. The office line inside the form reads Office 'SLCo. COUNCIL - C' and Office Sought 'Co. Council' with the District Number box LEFT BLANK - the At-Large C seat comes from the Office line, not from a district number. Party D. Signed 1-29-2019, clerk stamp 'RECEIVED IN OFFICE JAN 31 2019'. This is a Salt Lake County county office, not a school board. The chunk file's schedule_a value was 'not-inspected' - CORRECTED HERE: a county Schedule A page IS present (p3) with 13 filled rows and a Schedule B (p4) with 10. Street address / city / state / zip, the phone-fax-email band and the signature line are covered by the county's black bar (redacted at source).
